subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in 70-80 words.
guide_solution: Summary The text is about partiotism. Patriotism, we know, is a noble virtue that inspires a man to give self-interest and to do everything for the betterment of his country. Even a patriot his ready to sacrifice his our for his country. So he deserves profound honour. On the other hand, an unpatriotic person is dishonoured by everybody. Inspite of his having money, power and knowledge, he is very ignoble. He dies twice. In his life time he dies by possessing a dead soul. After his physical death no one mourns for him.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Pabna Cadet College . Sl. No. 04; Page No. 47
